@dreamp/world-ocean · three r186 · WebGPU + TSL

Ocean WebGPU Port

Porting the FFT ocean from WebGL2 / three 0.180 to WebGPU / TSL on three r186 as the @dreamp/world-ocean engine module. Low tier first, then medium, high and ultra; each piece is built, then reviewed against the WebGL reference by a separate critic until it passes.

Outstanding issues

  • lowBrightness comparisons: the WebGL reference page darkens its canvas with a CSS overlay (top 20 %, bottom 40 %) that is baked into the reference shots. With it applied to the port, the default view's luminance is 119.0 vs 119.6.
  • highCore workers: a late snapshot job can corrupt heights by up to 7 m; a worker crash hangs the main thread.
  • highCore: tick + gameplay queries p99 6.8–8.7 ms (target < 4 ms, workers off).
  • highCPU heightAt inversion fails near steep crests (storm: 0.6 m error); parity max < 2 % Hs passes 8/32 cases.
  • mediumFoam history reset restarts from zero and never recovers while paused; foam pass read not declared.
  • mediumDecision needed: the drawn surface is view-dependent (vertex mips beyond ~20 m, far fade from 200 m); define the parity target.
  • mediumREADME.md, TUNING.md (per-tier cost table) and HANDOFF.md not written yet.
  • lowSpec test command 'node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/' fails on Node 22.14 (directory argument); works with a glob. Engine targets Node 24.
